Fixed header-key canonicalization end-to-end. Root cause: meta.Resolve canonicalized header keys (http.CanonicalHeaderKey) but meta.Merge matched/deleted on the raw JSON key, so a PATCH .../meta deleting 'content-type' against a stored 'Content-Type' silently no-opped, and case-variant keys could collide non-deterministically at resolution (Resolve iterates the map in random order). Fix: canonicalize header keys at parse time — FromJSON and FromYAML now normalize content.headers, so every stored, merged, and resolved document holds canonical keys end-to-end; case-variant collisions collapse deterministically (lexicographically-last raw key wins). Merge additionally made case-insensitive so it is correct standalone; Resolve's existing canonicalization kept as defense-in-depth for struct-built docs. Tests added: FromJSON canonicalization + deterministic collision collapse (document_test.go), Merge case-insensitive override/removal (merge_test.go). gofmt/vet/build/lint/full test suite all green. Implemented on branch claude/artifactsd-1it/separate-admin-origin (PR: https://github.com/jdelic/artifactsd/pull/new/claude/artifactsd-1it/separate-admin-origin).

Adds the optional hardened topology (design/14 §10). Single-domain remains the default.

- Config: ARTIFACTSD_ADMIN_HOST (--admin-host); Server.AdminBaseURL() + config.HostOnly() helpers; validation rejects a URL form or a host equal to base-URL host.
- internal/server/adminorigin.go hostIsolationGate: dispatches by request host — admin plane (admin UI under Admin.Path + /auth/oidc/*) only on the admin host, public plane (/c,/s,robots,sitemap) only on the public host, cross-plane => 404. Shared bearer/cookie-less routes (/api/v1, health) on both. Honors X-Forwarded-Host under --trust-proxy. Wired at end of routes().
- Cookie scoping: session cookie is host-only already (no Domain) → scopes to admin host since the OIDC callback runs there. OIDC redirect URL now defaults to <admin_base>/auth/oidc/callback.
- CSRF sameOrigin accepts both public and admin origins (admin posts carry admin-host Origin) — fixes what would otherwise 403 every admin mutation in this mode.
- URL builders unchanged: artifact/share URLs already use public BaseURL, admin links host-relative.
- Management API decision: rides on BOTH hosts (bearer-only, no ambient cookie) — documented.

Tests: host-gate matrix both topologies + single-domain no-op + CSRF same-origin (adminorigin_test.go), config parse/validate/redirect-default (config_test.go). Docs: design/14 §10 (now implemented), design/12 §1, docs/configuration.md. make check + make smoke green.

Default prints the unit to stdout (install hint on stderr); --install writes /etc/systemd/system/<unit>.service or ~/.config/systemd/user (XDG-aware), creates an env-file skeleton only if missing (0640, never clobbers an edited file), and prints systemctl next steps incl. the one-time useradd for system/local server. local runtime = generating binary via os.Executable with hardening from packaging example (StateDirectory data via %S, DynamicUser for the stateless MCP adapter, ProtectHome only system-scope); docker/podman = release image registry.maurus.net/agent-tools/artifactsd:latest via 'run --rm' + --env-file, artifactsd-data volume for the server, docker.service dependency only for system-scope docker. Assumptions recorded: default component=server, default runtime=local, unit names artifactsd/artifactsd-mcp, added --image override. make check + make smoke green; verified by driving the built binary and systemd-analyze verify on generated units (only host-env noise). Docs: installation.md systemd section rewritten around the generator, mcp.md pointer added. PR: https://github.com/jdelic/artifactsd/pull/new/claude/artifactsd-46t/systemd-generator

Root cause: layout was fluid and the viewport meta was present, but the top menu bar's min-content width (~730px at the 18px TUI font: 7 nav items + email + logout, plus wide tables) exceeded phone-portrait viewports; the flex items overflowed the viewport-wide .nc-screen onto the black body and mobile Safari zoomed the page out to fit (measured: pre-fix portrait rendered 757px on a 430px device). Fix (CSS-only + one-line viewport meta change): @media (max-width:780px) wraps the topbar/footer into TUI-style rows, makes wide .nc-table scroll inside its panel, breaks long paths/URLs (overflow-wrap:anywhere), ellipsizes the user email, bounds form inputs, caps tooltips to 85vw, and adds a body overflow-x:clip guard; shell-level viewport-fit=cover + safe-area insets paint blue (not black) behind the iPhone notch/home indicator, min-height:100dvh, bars use min-height (+ .nc-status align-self:stretch, identical on one row). Landscape/desktop rendering unchanged (breakpoint 780px < 814px landscape viewport; verified desktop screenshot pixel-equivalent). Verified with Playwright (chromium, iPhone 14 Pro Max portrait/landscape + 1440px desktop) against a live server with admin basic auth: post-fix docWidth==viewport everywhere, no overflow. No CSS-class unit tests per feedback convention. Branch claude/artifactsd-bhn/mobile-css, PR: https://github.com/jdelic/artifactsd/pull/new/claude/artifactsd-bhn/mobile-css
